verdict.rationale: The reviewer's concern holds: no item in the pack names or documents an official Auth0 SDK. The closest items don't qualify. The framework list in auth0-docs-109 names third-party frameworks (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK), not Auth0 SDKs. The quickstarts and 'few lines of code' claims are vague. Community praise for 'open source packages' isn't documentation of an official SDK. The CLI, MCP server, Terraform module and Agent Skills are different capabilities that belong to other stories. The axis clearly applies to an auth platform, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.
